section: Ocean acidification - causes, effects on marine ecosystems and coral reefs

accepted.s: According to the 7th Status of the World's Coral Reefs report of the Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network (GCRMN), the decline in hard coral cover compared with the 1980–2009 baseline was approximately:
accepted.x: The GCRMN 7th Status of the World's Coral Reefs report recorded a 9.5% decline in hard coral cover compared with the 1980–2009 period.
accepted.tq: Use the numerical-value distinction and compare the stated figure with the baseline period.

accepted.s: The finding that 87% of the world's coral reefs experienced unprecedented heat stress in 2024 was highlighted in which of the following?
o: The GCRMN 7th Status of the World's Coral Reefs report, cited by LENSD on 2 September 2026
The APSES 2024–25 report on sustainable fishing
The APPCA 2026 report on Kadmat coral colonies
The SDG 14 ranking released by NITI Aayog in 2024
accepted.x: The 87% figure for unprecedented heat stress in 2024 was reported in the GCRMN coral-reef assessment and cited by LENSD on 2 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the finding with the correct report and date rather than relying on a familiar organisation name.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the policy context of marine conservation in Andhra Pradesh:
1. SDG 14 is not ranked by NITI Aayog.
2. Andhra Pradesh plans to increase Marine Protected Areas.
3. Andhra Pradesh plans to promote sustainable fishing.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. SDG 14 is not ranked by NITI Aayog, while Andhra Pradesh has plans concerning expanded Marine Protected Areas and sustainable fishing.
accepted.tq: Check each statement independently, especially the institutional distinction between NITI Aayog and Andhra Pradesh policy planning.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the reef character of Lakshadweep?
o: It is entirely composed of atoll reefs.
It is entirely composed of barrier reefs.
It contains only deep-sea cold-water reefs.
It is entirely composed of fringing reefs.
accepted.x: Lakshadweep is entirely characterised by atoll reefs. The descriptions of fringing, barrier and deep-sea cold-water reefs are not applicable to the stated comparison.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among the closely related reef-formation terms: fringing, barrier and atoll.

accepted.s:
With reference to the coral colony reported from Kadmat, consider the following statements:
1. It belongs to the species Pavona clavus.
2. It is described as a giant ‘potato patch coral’ colony.
3. It was reported in the APPCA 2026 context.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The giant coral colony found at Kadmat is identified as Pavona clavus, commonly described as potato patch coral, and is associated with the APPCA 2026 report.
accepted.tq: Combine the species, descriptive name and reporting reference; the all-correct code is the precise option.
